title: Finite free evaluation over an affine direct-image algebra is epi iff surjective on affine sections
statement: Let $f:U\to X$ be an affine morphism [pqf-def-affine-morphism] of schemes [def-pc-scheme], let $\mathcal F$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_U$-module [pqf-def-coherent], and put $\mathcal A=f_*\mathcal O_U$ and $\mathcal N=f_*\mathcal F$, with $\mathcal A(T)=\mathcal O_U(f^{-1}T)$ acting on $\mathcal N(T)=\mathcal F(f^{-1}T)$ [def-pc-module-pullback]. Let $V\subseteq X$ be an affine open and $I$ a finite set. For compatible sections $s_i$ of $\mathcal N|_V$, let $\phi:\bigoplus_{i\in I}\mathcal A|_V\to\mathcal N|_V$ be the $\mathcal A|_V$-linear map sending its $i$th basis section to $s_i$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-pbc-generating-sections]. Then $\phi$ is an epimorphism of sheaves of modules if and only if $\phi_V:\mathcal A(V)^I\to\mathcal N(V)$ is surjective. No finite-type assumption on $\mathcal N$ or $\mathcal F$ is made.

source.place: Tag 0897 (coherent-lemma-graded-finiteness), proof, omitted finite-type detail; Tag 01SB (morphisms-lemma-affine-equivalence-modules), affine-local equivalence; Tag 01IC, exactness of tilde and quasi-coherent images. This is the finite-free evaluation argument of steps 2 and 3 of lem-weil-pbc-affine-module-finite-type.

proof.text: Put W = f^{-1}(V) and B = O_U(W). W is affine. A|V sends an open Vprime to O_U(f^{-1}(Vprime)). For finite I the free A|V-module has sections A(Vprime)^I, with the usual basis. The direct image of the free O_W-module has these same sections and restrictions: finite direct sums are finite products, and pushforward preserves products. Thus their canonical basis comparison is an isomorphism. The chosen sections s define the O_W-linear evaluation psi: O_W^I -> F|W, and its direct image is the specified A|V-linear evaluation phi.

Suppose phi is epi. For t in F(W) = (f_*F)(V), the local-surjectivity description of a generating evaluation supplies a covering V = union Vk and finite coefficient vectors in A(Vk)^I lifting the restriction of t. The preimages f^{-1}(Vk) cover W, and the same coefficient vectors lift t locally through psi. Hence t belongs to the sheaf image of psi on W. Both source and target of psi are quasi-coherent. The affine image formula identifies its sheaf image sections on W with the range of psi_W, so t has a global lift in B^I. By the basis comparison, phi_V is surjective.

Conversely suppose phi_V is surjective. The basis comparison says psi_W: B^I -> F(W) is surjective. The quasi-coherent affine tilde/Gamma correspondence identifies psi with the tilde of this module map, and tilde preserves cokernels, so psi is epi. For each affine Vprime contained in V, its preimage Wprime is affine. The affine image formula for psi gives surjectivity of psi on Wprime. The coefficients of each lift are O_U(Wprime)^I = A(Vprime)^I, so the basis comparison gives a lift through phi on Vprime. Affine Vprime form a basis of V. Thus every section on an arbitrary open inside V locally lifts through phi; phi is epi.
